newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells 4.3 pct of hotel group at auction.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells 4.3 pct of hotel group at auction.

text.p: Croatia's privatisation agency sold a share stake in a hotel company Central d.d. Bjelovar at auction on Thursday, the Zagreb Stock Exchange reported.
A block of 2,000 shares in Central d.d Bjelovar, 4.3 percent of its total stock, went to FIMA brokerage for a total of 714,160 kuna (200,000 German marks).
The privatisation fund last week approved a 30 percent reduction of final prices for cash payments.

The interest for remaining state assets has waned after the most attractive firms went, some at a discount for public debt bonds. This was the first auction since mid-June, when smaller share packages in two firms were sold.
